item.title: People Power Party's Supreme Council Says of ‘Collar-Grabbing’ Kwon Young-jin: “Maximum Discipline, Including Expulsion, Required” (‘멱살’ 권영진에 국힘 최고위 “제명 포함 최고 수준 징계해야”)
item.description:
On the 27th, the leadership of the People Power Party (PPP) reached a consensus that second-term lawmaker Kwon Young-jin, who grabbed the collar of Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik in protest over committee assignments, should face maximum disciplinary action, including expulsion, if he does not voluntarily leave the party. On the same day, the Central Ethics Committee began disciplinary proceedings against Kwon, along with lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae and Jin Jong-oh. (국민의힘 지도부가 국회 상임위원회 배정에 불만을 제기하며 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡은 재선 권영진 의원에 대해 스스로 탈당하지 않으면 제명 등 최고 수준의 징계를 해야 한다고 27일 의견을 모았다. 이날 중앙윤리위원회는 권 의원을 포함해 조경태, 진종오 의원에 대한 징계 절차에 들어갔다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon told reporters after a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly, “We recommended that (Kwon) voluntarily resign from the party. If he does not accept this, we will promptly convene the Ethics Committee to initiate the highest possible level of discipline, including expulsion.” On the 23rd, after being assigned as the secretary of the Public Administration and Security Committee instead of the National Assembly’s Intelligence Committee, Kwon grabbed Floor Leader Jeong by the collar in his office and protested aggressively. (박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의 뒤 기자들과 만나 “(권 의원에게) 자진 탈당을 권유하고, 이를 받아들이지 않으면 신속하게 윤리위원회를 소집해 제명을 포함해 가능한 최고 수준의 징계를 시작할 것”이라고 말했다. 권 의원은 지난 23일 자신이 국회 정보위원회 간사가 아닌 행정안전위원회 간사로 배정되자 국회 원내대표실에서 정 원내대표의 멱살을 잡고 거칠게 항의했다.)

Four days after the ‘collar-grabbing incident,’ Kwon visited Floor Leader Jeong to apologize. Later, Kwon told reporters, “Regardless of the reasons, my actions and words last Thursday were insufficient and wrong.” However, regarding his intention to leave the party, he remained vague, saying, “I’ll leave it at this.” Floor Leader Jeong stated, “Lawmaker Kwon offered a sincere apology, and I accepted it,” but added, “Since lawmakers need time to think about (Kwon’s future), I have convened a general meeting of lawmakers on Thursday (the 30th). Please watch and see.” (권 의원은 ‘멱살 사태’ 나흘 만에 정 원내대표를 찾아 사과했다. 권 의원은 이후 기자들에게 “제가 지난 목요일 했던 언행은 이유 여하를 불문하고 부족하고 잘못한 것”이라면서도 탈당 의사에 대해서는 “이 정도로 하겠다”고 말을 아꼈다. 정 원내대표는 “권 의원께서 진심 어린 사과를 했고, 저 역시 수용했다”면서도 “(권 의원의 거취에 대해) 의원들이 생각할 시간이 필요할 것이기 때문에 목요일(오는 30일) 의원총회를 소집했다. 지켜봐 달라”고 말을 아꼈다.)

Some speculate that Kwon is facing harsher punishment because he belongs to ‘Alternatives and Future,’ a group of young lawmakers who had called for the resignation of Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk. Although ‘Alternatives and Future’ has not issued a separate statement, Woo Jae-jun, a Supreme Council member from the group, wrote on Facebook, “As long as the leadership continues its biased operations, it is difficult to expect a fair judgment from the Ethics Committee on Kwon’s case either.” (일각에선 권 의원이 장동혁 대표 사퇴를 촉구했던 소장파 의원 모임인 ‘대안과 미래’ 소속인 탓에 가중처벌되는 것 아니냐는 뒷말도 나온다. ‘대안과 미래’는 별도 입장을 내지 않았지만, 이 모임 소속인 우재준 최고위원은 페이스북에 “지도부부터 편향적 운영을 계속하는 한, 권 의원 사안에서도 윤리위의 공정한 판단을 기대하기는 어렵다”고 적었다.)

Meanwhile, the Central Ethics Committee held a meeting and announced the initiation of disciplinary proceedings against Kwon; Cho Kyung-tae, who is known to have made calls to ruling party lawmakers to encourage the defeat of National Assembly Vice Speaker Park Deok-heum, a former rival in an internal party primary, during the election of the opposition party’s vice speaker in a plenary session; and Jin Jong-oh, who supported independent candidate Han Dong-hoon in the June 3 election. (이런 가운데 중앙윤리위원회는 회의를 열어 권 의원을 포함해 국회 본회의에서 야당 몫 국회 부의장을 선출하는 과정에서 당내 경선 경쟁자였던 박덕흠 국회부의장의 낙선을 유도하는 전화를 여당 의원들에게 돌린 것으로 알려진 조경태 의원과 6·3 선거 때 무소속 한동훈 후보를 지원한 진종오 의원에 대한 징계를 개시했다고 발표했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho hints at resignation saying “new wine in new wineskins,” but presidential office says “no official statement made” (정성호 장관 “새 술은 새 부대에” 사의…청 “공식 표명 없었다”)
item.description:
Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho effectively signaled his resignation on the 27th regarding his future, stating, “Shouldn’t new wine be put into new wineskins?” However, the presidential office drew a line, saying, “Minister Jeong’s official resignation has not been confirmed, and the claim of resignation is not true.” This is interpreted as a委婉 communication of President Lee Jae-myung’s intention that it is difficult to accept the resignation. <<> Appearing at a plenary session of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee at the National Assembly that day, Minister Jeong responded to a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won, who asked, “Is the resignation claim true?” by saying, “Once the Prosecution Service and the Major Crimes Investigation Office are launched on October 2, I believe 95% of prosecution reform will be achieved.” He added, “Because the big framework of prosecution reform is complete, I have thought, even before former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok’s announcement on abolishing supplementary investigation powers, that new wine should be put in new wineskins.” Minister Jeong further noted, “My health is very poor. I have had quite severe sleep disorders for several months. Considering that aspect, I had been discussing this with those close to the president.” This reaffirmed his earlier statement on the 25th that, “While I haven’t directly spoken to the president, my intention to resign has been conveyed through aides for a long time.” Minister Jeong has previously expressed concerns about abolishing supplementary investigation powers, emphasizing that “it is important to ensure there are no victims among the 1% who are unfairly treated.” <<> That day, the presidential office drew a line, saying, “No official resignation has been confirmed.” A presidential office official stated during a briefing in Brazil, where President Lee is on a state visit, that “what has been reported in many news outlets is not true” and added that a cabinet reshuffle “has no set or predicted schedule.” Minister Jeong’s status is expected to be resolved after President Lee returns from his U.S. and South America tour next month on the 3rd. <<> Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr, Brasília/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (정성호 법무부 장관이 27일 자신의 거취 문제와 관련해 “새 술은 새 부대에 담아야 하지 않겠나”라며 사실상 사의를 표명했다. 그러나 청와대는 “정 장관의 공식 사의 표명이 확인된 바 없고, 사의 표명은 사실이 아니다”라며 선을 그었다. 사의를 수용하기 어렵다는 이재명 대통령의 뜻을 완곡하게 전달한 것으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: Minister Chung Seong-ho's Resignation... "Complete Prosecution Reform" Calls Within the Democratic Party (정성호 장관 사의에…민주당 내 “검찰개혁 마무리해달라”)
item.description:
The ruling party is facing confusion over the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers. Minister of Justice Chung Seong-ho, who had advocated a cautious approach, effectively announced his resignation in the National Assembly, but the presidential office denied the resignation itself and moved to manage the situation. Within the Democratic Party of Korea, voices urged, "Complete the prosecution reform." (여권이 ‘검찰 보완수사권 폐지’를 담은 형사소송법 개정 국면에서 혼선을 빚고 있다. 신중론을 펴온 정성호 법무부 장관은 국회에서 사실상 사퇴 의사를 밝혔으나 청와대는 사의 표명 사실 자체를 부인하며 수습에 나섰다. 더불어민주당 안에서는 “검찰개혁을 마무리해달라”는 목소리가 이어졌다.)

On the 27th, Minister Chung stated at the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee plenary session that "new wine should be put into new wineskins," expressing his intention to step down as minister. The surface reasons for his resignation include the prosecution reform work, which is set to divide the prosecution into an indictment agency and a major crimes investigation agency by October, entering its final phase, as well as health issues. (정 장관은 27일 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의에서 “새 술은 새 부대에 담아야 한다”며 장관직에서 물러나겠다는 의사를 밝혔다. 오는 10월 검찰을 공소청(기소)과 중대범죄수사청(수사)으로 분리하는 검찰개혁 작업이 마무리 국면에 접어들었고, 건강상의 문제도 있다는 게 사의를 표명한 표면적인 이유다.)

However, in political circles, this coincides with the ruling party adopting a bill to completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers as party policy and vowing to pass it in a plenary session on the 30th. This has led to interpretations that Minister Chung may have indirectly expressed dissatisfaction with the ruling party's push for legislation. This is because Minister Chung has consistently maintained the position that abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers could lead to various side effects and that alternatives are needed. At the same Legislation and Judiciary Committee meeting, Chung said, "Since the big framework of prosecution reform is concluded, I think technical issues remain," adding, "In that sense, I think a new stance may also be necessary." This could be interpreted as implying that a new minister who agrees with the ruling party's legislative stance on abolishing supplementary investigative powers should finish the reform work. (하지만 정치권에선 여당이 검사의 보완수사권을 완전 폐지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 당론으로 채택하고 오는 30일 본회의 처리를 공언한 시점과 맞물리면서, 정 장관이 여당의 입법 강행에 우회적으로 불만을 표출한 것 아니냐는 해석이 나온다. 정 장관은 그동안 검찰의 보완수사권을 폐지하면 여러 부작용이 발생할 수 있다며 대안이 필요하다는 입장을 견지해왔기 때문이다. 정 장관은 이날 법사위에서도 “(검찰개혁의) 큰 틀이 결론이 나 있기 때문에 기술적인 문제들이 남았다고 생각한다”며 “그런 면에서 새로운 입장도 필요한 게 아닌가 생각하고 있다”고 했다. 여당의 보완수사권 폐지 입법 기조에 동의하는 새 장관이 검찰개혁 작업을 마무리해야 한다는 발언으로 해석할 수 있는 대목이다.)

The presidential office drew a line on the same day, stating, "The Minister of Justice's resignation has not been officially confirmed. The resignation is not true." This is seen as President Lee Jae-myung effectively discouraging Minister Chung's resignation to ensure the smooth establishment of the major crimes investigation agency and indictment agency. During a video conference of senior secretaries presided over by President Lee, who was on a state visit to Brazil, he urged, "Prepare thoroughly for the opening of the major crimes investigation agency," while also instructing, "It is important to distinguish public and private matters in public service and uphold the principle of putting public good before personal interest." Accepting Minister Chung's resignation now could also be burdensome as it might confirm the conflict between the ruling party and the government over supplementary investigative powers. (청와대는 이날 “법무부 장관의 사의 표명은 공식적으로 확인된 바 없다. 사의 표명은 사실이 아니다”라며 선 긋기에 나섰다. 이재명 대통령이 중수청·공소청 안착을 위해 정 장관의 사의를 사실상 만류한 것으로 풀이된다. 이 대통령이 국빈 방문 중인 브라질에서 주재한 화상 수석보좌관회의에서 “중수청 개청 준비에 만전을 기하라”고 당부하는 한편 “공직 사회에서 공사를 구분하고 선공후사 원칙이 잘 지켜지는 게 중요하다”고 지시한 것도 같은 맥락으로 보인다. 지금 정 장관의 사의를 수용하면 보완수사권을 둘러싼 ‘당정’ 갈등이 기정사실화할 수 있다는 점도 부담스러운 대목이다.)

Within the Democratic Party, voices also urged Minister Chung to reconsider his resignation. (민주당에서도 정 장관의 사의를 말리는 목소리가 이어졌다.)

Lawmaker Park Ji-won said at the Legislation and Judiciary Committee meeting, "Your health can hold out until the end of the year," adding, "Even if you die, the stance for an aide is to succeed the president and die." Lawmaker Kim Nam-hee also said in a radio interview with MBC, "Since various laws will take effect in October, I think it would be better for you to finish them yourself." Another lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh*, "This happened because the government and the president's thoughts were not considered during the creation of the prosecution reform plan," adding, "From the presidential office's perspective, there is no suitable person, so them saying they'll leave must be awkward." (박지원 의원은 법사위 회의에서 “건강이 금년 말까지는 견딜 수 있다”며 “죽더라도 대통령을 성공시키고 죽는 자세가 측근한테 필요하다”고 말했다. 김남희 의원도 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 인터뷰에서 “10월에 여러가지 법들의 실행이 있기 때문에 본인이 마무리하시는 게 더 좋지 않을까 생각한다”고 말했다. 다른 한 의원은 한겨레에 “검찰개혁안이 만들어지는 과정에서 정부와 대통령이 생각하는 게 고려되지 않다 보니 그런 것”이라며 “청와대 입장에서도 마땅한 사람이 없는데 나간다고 하니 난감한 것 아니겠는가”라고 했다.)

The People Power Party attacked, calling it "the peak of irresponsibility." Spokesperson Cho Yong-sul commented, "As the abolition of supplementary investigative powers enters its final countdown, key figures in the Lee Jae-myung administration are plotting to step down to avoid the stigma of being 'the primary responsible parties for dismantling the national safety net.'" Lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek also said, "Because of the Democratic Party's national convention, they are trying to complete the abolition of supplementary investigative powers before the convention without reasonable discussion, and since the minister opposes it, isn't that why he announced his resignation?" (국민의힘은 “무책임의 극치”라며 공세를 폈다. 조용술 대변인은 “보완수사권 폐지가 초읽기에 들어가자 이재명 정권의 핵심 인사들이 ‘국민 안전망 해체의 1호 책임자’라는 오명을 피하기 위해 자리에서 물러날 궁리부터 하고 있다”고 논평했다. 곽규택 의원도 “민주당 전당대회 때문에 합리적 논의 없이 전대 전에 보완수사권 폐지를 완성하려 하는 것이고, 장관은 그에 반대하니 사의 표명을 한 것 아니냐”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Ethics Committee Launches 'Disciplinary Crackdown'...Disciplinary Proceedings Begin for Kwon Young-jin, Cho Kyung-tae, and Jin Jong-oh (국힘 윤리위, ‘징계정국’ 가동…권영진·조경태·진종오 징계 개시)
item.description:
The Central Ethics Committee of the People Power Party (PPP) initiated disciplinary proceedings on the 27th against lawmakers Kwon Young-jin, Cho Kyung-tae, and Jin Jong-oh. This move, triggered by the incident involving lawmaker Kwon who grabbed the collar of floor leader Jeong Jungsik, appears to have included even pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmakers in the disciplinary targets, marking the start of the disciplinary session that leader Jang Dong-hyuk had previously warned about. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 27일 권영진·조경태·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 절차를 개시했다. 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡는 등 물의를 빚은 권 의원 사건을 고리로 친한동훈(친한)계 의원들까지 징계 대상에 포함하며 장동혁 대표가 예고한 징계 정국에 들어간 모양새다.)

The PPP ethics committee held a closed-door meeting at a location in Yeouido, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, starting at 2 p.m. that day, with three members including committee chairman Yoon Min-woo present, and made this decision. Currently, the ethics committee operates as a five-member body after two of its original seven members resigned. While there were predictions that the initiation of disciplinary proceedings would be difficult because two ethics committee members were absent that day, Chairman Yoon pushed ahead with the decision. Vice-chairman Woo Jong-hwan and others who were absent expressed opposition to Chairman Yoon's unilateral operation and plan to demand prior coordination of the decision text. (국민의힘 윤리위는 이날 오후 2시부터 서울 영등포구 여의도 모처에서 윤민우 윤리위원장 등 3명이 참석한 가운데 비공개회의를 열고 이렇게 의결했다. 현재 윤리위는 위원 2명이 사퇴해 기존 7명에서 5인 체제로 운영되고 있다. 이날 윤리위원 2명이 불참하면서 징계 개시가 어려울 것이란 관측도 나왔으나, 윤 위원장은 의결을 강행했다. 이날 불참한 우종환 부위원장 등은 윤 위원장의 독단적 운영에 반발하며 추후 결정문 사전 조율 등을 요구하겠단 입장이다.)

Lawmaker Kwon was reported after grabbing the collars of floor leader Jeong and others while expressing dissatisfaction over the allocation of standing committee assignments. Earlier that day, the PPP leadership agreed at a Supreme Council meeting to recommend that Kwon voluntarily leave the party, and warned that if he did not comply, the ethics committee would take the highest level of disciplinary action, including expulsion. Some are murmuring that Kwon may face harsher punishment because he belongs to 'Alternatives and Future,' a group of younger lawmakers. Woo Jae-joon, a Supreme Council member who also belongs to this group, pointed out on Facebook, "As long as the leadership continues biased operations, it is difficult to expect a fair judgment from the ethics committee even in the case of lawmaker Kwon." (권 의원은 상임위원회 배정에 불만을 표출하는 과정에서 정 원내대표 등의 멱살을 잡아 제소됐다. 국민의힘 지도부는 앞서 이날 최고위원회의에서 권 의원에게 자진 탈당을 권유하기로 의견을 모았고, 권 의원이 응하지 않을 경우 윤리위에서 제명을 포함한 최고 수위 징계 처분에 나서겠다고 경고했다. 일각에선 권 의원이 소장파 의원 모임인 ‘대안과 미래’ 소속인 탓에 가중처벌되는 것 아니냐는 뒷말도 나온다. 이 모임 소속인 우재준 최고위원은 페이스북에 “지도부부터 편향적 운영을 계속하는 한, 권 의원 사안에서도 윤리위의 공정한 판단을 기대하기는 어렵다”고 지적했다.)

Within the party, there is an interpretation that this move, which brings both Kwon, whose discipline is unavoidable, and figures who have led the push for leader Jang's resignation under disciplinary action, is aimed at minimizing backlash. Lawmaker Cho, who campaigned against the election of Deputy National Assembly Speaker Park Deok-heum as the opposition party's representative during the process of electing the deputy speaker at a plenary session of the National Assembly, had previously reported leader Jang to the ethics committee, calling for his expulsion or removal from the party. Lawmaker Jin is under suspicion of dispatching aides to support independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon during the June 3 by-election in Busan's Buk-gu district. However, a party leadership official commented, "They probably just put forward the three people most likely to gain consensus among lawmakers." (당내에선 징계가 불가피한 권 의원과 함께 장 대표 퇴진에 앞장서온 인사들을 징계 대상에 올리면서 반발을 최소화하려는 것 아니냐는 해석이 나온다. 야당 몫 국회부의장을 국회 본회의에서 선출하는 과정에서 박덕흠 국회부의장 낙선 운동을 벌인 조 의원은 장 대표를 윤리위에 제소하며 제명·출당 조치를 해야 한다고 주장한 바 있다. 진 의원은 6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 때 보좌진을 파견해 한동훈 무소속 의원을 지원했다는 의혹을 받고 있다. 다만 당 지도부 관계자는 “의원들이 가장 공감할 세 사람을 우선 올린 게 아니겠나”라고 했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Runners heading to Chungcheong... Kim says: “A worker to end the Myeong-Cheong battle,” Jeong says: “One-root spirit” (충청 달려간 주자들…김 “명청대전 끝낼 일꾼” 정 “한뿌리 정신”)
item.description:
Candidates Song Young-gil, Kim Min-seok, and Jeong Cheong-rae (in order of ballot number), who are challenging for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, all headed to the Chungcheong region on the 27th, the first stop for the August 17th party convention’s regional primary. This move came a day before the start of voting for party members in the Chungcheong area, aiming to gain an early advantage in the central region. Candidates Song and Kim warned that if Candidate Jeong succeeds in his re-election as party leader, the conflict between the party and the presidential office would intensify, thus moving to check Jeong. Meanwhile, Candidate Jeong emphasized, “The Democratic Party is strongest when it stays true to itself,” targeting the party’s traditional support base. <<> Candidate Song held a press conference at the briefing room of the Chungnam Provincial Government in Hongseong County, Chungnam, on the morning of the 27th. He stated, “Even though the president has indirectly and directly indicated differences in perception with Candidate Jeong, insisting there is no conflict between the party and the presidential office is difficult to convince the public,” and added, “While it’s unlikely Candidate Jeong will become party leader, if he does, the president would fall into a lame-duck status, and the party-presidential office conflict would worsen.” Song also said, “I will make Chungnam the capital of AI (artificial intelligence),” and “Ensure Chungnam becomes the biggest beneficiary in areas such as the swift relocation of secondary public institutions.” Afterwards, Candidate Song, along with candidate for Supreme Council member Seo Mi-hwa, visited the Yu Gwan-sun Martyr Memorial Hall and the birthplace of Lee Dong-nyeong in Cheonan, Chungnam, before holding a town hall meeting with party members in Chungnam. In the evening, he continued with a town hall meeting for party members in Sejong. <<> Candidate Kim, during a meeting with party members in Cheongju, North Chungcheong, on the same day, emphasized his suitability as party leader, saying, “The selection criteria are clear. We need a reliable worker to end the party-government conflict and the Myeong-Cheong battle.” Kim, who was born in Seoul, mentioned that he had ties to Cheongju, recalling his experience of being detained at Cheongju Prison during his university days for participating in democratization movements. Kim also highlighted his attention to local issues by holding consecutive meetings with Sejong Mayor Jo Sang-ho and North Chungcheong Governor Shin Yong-han, expressing his commitment to completing Sejong as an administrative capital and strengthening North Chungcheong’s bio, semiconductor, and secondary battery industries. This appears aimed at shifting the core message of the party convention toward policy, as Candidate Jeong’s side has recently intensified attacks, claiming Kim’s allegations of Shincheonji involvement are “baseless negativity that endangers the party.” <<> Candidate Jeong, whose hometown is Geumsan, Chungnam, emphasized his regional ties on Facebook, writing, “I am Jeong Cheong-rae, a son of Chungcheong born in Chungnam and raised in Daejeon. Show me the sentiment of Chungcheong.” Appearing on the YouTube channel ‘Maebulshow,’ he targeted the traditional support base, stating, “For the success of the Lee Jae-myung government, those who supported Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung must unite tightly with a one-root spirit,” and “To win the next presidential election, the pan-democratic and progressive camp must field a single candidate to face the conservative camp one-on-one.” In the afternoon, Jeong held a concert for party members in Cheongju, North Chungcheong, and expressed his intent to address local issues such as “building a national railroad network along the Gangho axis.” <<> On this day, the Democratic Party confirmed the electoral roll of 17,667 delegates and 1,527,261 party members with voting rights. The proportion of party members in the Chungcheong region among all eligible voting members is around 10%. However, it is widely assessed that the impact of the Chungcheong region’s voting results on the overall race is greater than this figure, given it is the first primary stop. At last year’s party convention, Candidate Jeong recorded a 66% vote share in the first primary region of Chungcheong, leading Candidate Park Chan-dae by over 20 percentage points, establishing an early trend of dominance.
